_README: Observed downstream flood extents, for validating ROUTING - the question
'if this lake releases, where does the water go and what does it hit'.
Until this file existed the project validated lake AREA and never once
checked a predicted corridor against what the flood actually did. That is
the difference between validating the input and validating the output.
Every entry is a published post-event observation, named. Distances are
along-channel from the source lake unless stated. Where sources disagree
the range is kept rather than averaged - same rule as the reporter.

impacted_places: named settlements/assets the flood is DOCUMENTED to have hit, with along-channel distance. This is the sharpest available test of a routed corridor: not 'did it run far enough' but 'does it pass the place that was actually destroyed, at the right distance'.

released_volume_m3.note: ICIMOD gives 156,000 (upper lake) + 303,000 (lower) = 459,000. The NHESS reconstruction gives ~770,000 combined. Kept as a range.

thyanbo_tsho.debris_transport_note: Debris carried ~80 km along the Thame and Dudh Koshi rivers.
thyanbo_tsho.settlement_note: Thame village is ~10 km downstream of the source lakes; the flood reached it in 22-25 minutes, implying a mean front speed of roughly 7-8 m/s.
thyanbo_tsho.impacts: 135 displaced, 25 homes destroyed, school and health post damaged, losses > US$6.18 million.

impacted_places.name: Thame
impacted_places.what_happened: village struck 22-25 min after the outburst; homes, school and health post damaged, 135 displaced

released_volume_m3.note: Order-of-magnitude figure implied by the reported lake drawdown; treat as indicative, not measured.

south_lhonak.debris_transport_note: Inundation and deposition traced ~169 km down the Teesta.
south_lhonak.critical_asset_note: Chungthang dam (Teesta III, 1,200 MW) is ~60 km downstream and was destroyed.
south_lhonak.impacts: 24+ dead, 70+ missing, 13 bridges destroyed, 1,200 residences lost, >25,000 people affected.

released_volume_m3.note: No published release volume found. Absent rather than guessed.

pyurepu_supraglacial.critical_asset_note: The supraglacial source lake sat ~36 km upstream of Rasuwagadhi, where the Friendship Bridge was destroyed and the Timure dry port severely damaged.
pyurepu_supraglacial.impacts: 9 dead, 19 missing; roads, hydropower, schools, bridges and power supply damaged; losses in the billions of rupees.
sources: NDRRMA Rasuwa Glacial Flood Situation Report
ICIMOD / Stimson Center transboundary GLOF analysis (2025)

impacted_places.name: Rasuwagadhi
impacted_places.what_happened: Friendship Bridge to China destroyed; Timure dry port severely damaged
